name: add_tests_python_camel_to_snake
description: Write pytest tests for a camelCase -> snake_case converter with acronym handling; mutation-checked
prompts: camel_to_snake(name) in casing.py (already correct - do not modify it) converts camelCase/PascalCase identifiers to snake_case, with acronym handling: a run of capitals stays together up to (but not including) the last one before a following lowercase letter - so 'HTTPServer' becomes 'http_server' (not 'h_t_t_p_server'), and 'userID' becomes 'user_id'. Write pytest tests at exactly test_casing.py (functions named test_*, plain asserts with exact strings) with at least 4 test functions covering: a simple two-word camelCase name, a leading acronym like 'HTTPServer', a trailing acronym like 'userID', and a name with no case boundaries at all (already lowercase, unchanged). Import with `from casing import camel_to_snake`.

setup_files.casing.py:
import re

_BOUNDARY = re.compile(r"(?<=[a-z0-9])(?=[A-Z])|(?<=[A-Z])(?=[A-Z][a-z])")


def camel_to_snake(name):
    """'userID' -> 'user_id', 'HTTPServer' -> 'http_server',
    'simpleWord' -> 'simple_word'. Consecutive capitals (an acronym) stay
    together up to the last one before a following lowercase letter."""
    return _BOUNDARY.sub("_", name).lower()

test_setup_files.mutation_check.py:
"""Mutation harness: model tests must PASS the real implementation and FAIL
each mutant. Portable (sys.executable, list args, -B)."""
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

IMPL = Path('casing.py')
TEST = 'test_casing.py'
MUTANTS = [
    [
        "_BOUNDARY = re.compile(r\"(?<=[a-z0-9])(?=[A-Z])|(?<=[A-Z])(?=[A-Z][a-z])\")",
        "_BOUNDARY = re.compile(r\"(?<=[a-z0-9])(?=[A-Z])\")"
    ],
    [
        "    return _BOUNDARY.sub(\"_\", name).lower()",
        "    return _BOUNDARY.sub(\"_\", name)"
    ],
    [
        "_BOUNDARY = re.compile(r\"(?<=[a-z0-9])(?=[A-Z])|(?<=[A-Z])(?=[A-Z][a-z])\")",
        "_BOUNDARY = re.compile(r\"(?<=[A-Z])(?=[A-Z][a-z])\")"
    ]
]


def run_tests() -> int:
    for p in Path(".").rglob("__pycache__"):
        shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "pytest", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-q", TEST]
    ).returncode


src = IMPL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for old, _new in MUTANTS:
    assert src.count(old) == 1, (
        f"protected implementation file {IMPL} was modified - the task said not to "
        f"change it (anchor not found exactly once: {old!r})")

rc = run_tests()
assert rc == 0, f"model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit {rc})"

try:
    for i, (old, new) in enumerate(MUTANTS, 1):
        IMPL.write_text(src.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
        rc = run_tests()
        assert rc != 0, (
            f"mutation {i} SURVIVED: the tests still pass against a deliberately "
            f"broken implementation, so they do not verify the required behavior")
finally:
    IMPL.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")

print(f"PASS (killed all {len(MUTANTS)} mutants)")
